name: Juan Manuel Fangio
features: weathered olive skin, thinning fair hair swept back, pale blue eyes, broad face, heavy jaw, bow legs, stocky powerful build, calm unhurried expression
bio: El Chueco, the bandy-legged one, from a potato town in the Argentine pampas. Five world championships with four different marques, a record that stood half a century, and a win rate no one has approached since. He came second in the 1955 Mille Miglia driving the whole thousand miles alone, with no navigator, half an hour behind Moss.
